text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening claim in first paragraph","quality":"explicit position","description":"The essay states its stance on driverless cars right away so the reader knows exactly what it is arguing for."},{"evidence":"paragraphs on sensors, seat vibration, and take-over alerts","quality":"organized support","description":"The essay develops its position through separate body points that each connect a detail from the article to a reason driverless cars are beneficial."},{"evidence":"explains skids, fatigue, and backing into objects","quality":"elaborated reasoning","description":"The essay goes beyond naming article facts by explaining how those features would prevent accidents and improve safety."},{"evidence":"introduction, body, and concluding viewpoint","quality":"essay structure","description":"The response has a recognizable argumentative shape with a beginning, supporting middle, and ending that restates the claim."},{"evidence":"phrases like 'more beneficial than damaging' and 'outweigh the negative aspects'","quality":"consistent argumentation","description":"The essay keeps returning to one clear line of reasoning in favor of driverless cars instead of drifting into questions and uncertainty."}]}
